headline: On last trading day, Sensex recovered 300 points to 23,150, though indices ended the week lower after midweek volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 28 September.

why: Recovery in auto and consumer durable sectors during Friday's trading session
Sharp midweek sell-off triggered by crude oil prices surging above $100 per barrel
Investor concerns regarding proposed insurance curbs and global oil price spikes
Government decision to cut FY27 borrowing by ₹1.2 trillion to support fiscal targets
whatHappening: JSW One Platforms has filed draft papers for a ₹3,054 crore initial public offering
The government is evaluating financial bids for the strategic sale of IDBI Bank
Zee is seeking legal action against Reliance-Disney's JioStar over alleged copyright breaches
NSE chairman suggested allowing stock exchanges to list on their own trading platforms
summary: On the last trading day, Indian markets recovered with the Sensex gaining over 300 points to close near 23,150. Despite the Friday rebound, the indices ended the week lower following a significant midweek crash driven by surging oil prices. Key corporate developments include JSW One Platforms' IPO filing and the government's progress on the IDBI Bank sale.
